name: Jim Hawkins
role: the boy who tells most of the story; son of the Admiral Benbow's keepers

name: Mrs Hawkins
role: Jim's mother

name: Billy Bones, "the captain"
role: old buccaneer who lodges at the inn with Flint's map

looks.fact: tall, strong, heavy-built, with nut-brown skin
a tarry pigtail over a soiled blue coat
scarred hands with black, broken nails
a livid white sabre scar across one cheek

name: Dr Livesey
role: the doctor and magistrate; narrates part of the story

looks.fact: neat, with a powdered wig white as snow, bright black eyes, pleasant manners

name: Black Dog
role: Flint's old crewman who comes looking for Bones

looks.fact: a pale, waxy-faced man
two fingers missing from his left hand
carries a cutlass but does not look a fighter

name: Blind Pew
role: blind buccaneer who brings the black spot

looks.fact: blind, hunched as if with age or weakness, tapping before him with a stick
a green shade over his eyes and nose
a huge, tattered, hooded sea-cloak

name: Squire Trelawney
role: the local gentleman who buys and fits out the ship

looks.fact: tall, over six feet, and broad to match
a bluff, rough, weathered face, red and lined from travel
very black, quick-moving eyebrows

name: Long John Silver
role: the one-legged ship's cook and leader of the mutineers

looks.fact: left leg off close by the hip; gets about on a crutch with great skill
very tall and strong
a face as big as a ham, plain and pale, but clever and smiling

name: Captain Smollett
role: master of the Hispaniola

looks.fact: a sharp-looking man who seemed vexed with everything aboard

name: Captain Flint (the parrot)
role: Silver's parrot, named for the dead pirate captain

name: Dick Johnson
role: young hand Silver wins to the mutiny

name: Israel Hands
role: coxswain and gunner, one of the mutineers

name: O'Brien ("the red cap")
role: mutineer left aboard with Hands

looks.fact: wears a red night-cap
the man in the red cap is named here as O'Brien

name: Tom
role: loyal seaman who refuses Silver on the island

name: Ben Gunn
role: marooned former crewman of Flint's

looks.fact: skin burnt by the sun, even his lips black, his fair eyes startling in so dark a face
dressed in rags of old ship's canvas and sea-cloth, held together with brass buttons, sticks and tarred gaskin
a brass-buckled leather belt is the one solid thing he wears

name: Tom Redruth
role: the squire's old gamekeeper

name: Job Anderson
role: boatswain, a leader in the attack on the stockade

name: George Merry
role: mutineer who turns against Silver

name: Tom Morgan
role: old mutineer

name: Abraham Gray
role: carpenter's mate who stays loyal
